request.reason: Add the six release Work Item documentation projection paths already required by the repository Runtime so WI-1051 can create truthful in-progress tri-language pages and one parity row per language. This records the exact paths needed to satisfy the existing release projection gate; it does not change acceptance criteria, verification strength, release target, stable-version protection, rollback boundary, or any existing source scope.

authorization.authoritySource: The user directly authorized this exact scope expansion through Raydot on 2026-10-02 and instructed continuation without another approval request.

acceptanceCriteria: The release-candidate source contains the exact WI-1050 repair commit 09e7eead64bebacda98d71e1907c01e6008a8f88 and tree 3c2ac29a38ea1eb8d8e1c856424834761ab16630, and contains no Task9 changes.
A fresh macOS arm64 release build reports version 1.0.1-rc.1 and passes an isolated-prefix install/launch smoke check.
The WI-1050 amendment-admission positive and unauthorized fail-closed/zero-write regression checks are present and pass; supported legacy Contract/amendment receipts remain readable.

After publication, the exact v1.0.1-rc.1 provider release is marked prerelease and contains only the macOS arm64 executable plus matching SHA-256 checksum; downloading that exact asset and verifying its bytes against the checksum is post-publication evidence and remains pending until publication.
Before publication, record that v1.0.0 is the latest stable release; after publication, recheck that v1.0.0 remains latest stable.
Release notes state that Runtime review/verification, hosted CI, and non-macOS targets remain unverified unless separately proven before publication.

Before publication, review and include instructions to withdraw only v1.0.1-rc.1 and remove only its exact candidate assets/tag using normal GitHub permissions without changing v1.0.0; do not execute withdrawal or deletion as a pre-publication check.

Before publication, generate and verify a SHA-256 sidecar for the final local macOS arm64 RC executable and bind the artifact and sidecar to the exact candidate source; this does not claim publication or downloaded-asset verification.
previousContract.goal: Prepare and publish v1.0.1-rc.1 as a GitHub prerelease with one macOS arm64 executable and checksum; bind source repair commit 09e7eead64bebacda98d71e1907c01e6008a8f88; disclose unresolved Runtime review and verification, unverified hosted and non-macOS targets, and rollback/removal steps. Keep v1.0.0 as latest stable.

intent.businessGoal: Let macOS arm64 operators trial the WI-1050 Contract-amendment admission repair before Task9 migration work proceeds, while preserving v1.0.0 as the latest stable release.
constraints: Publish only v1.0.1-rc.1 for macOS arm64, and only when normal GitHub permissions allow.
Do not claim Runtime review or verification, hosted CI, or non-macOS validation that has not been performed.
nonGoals: A stable release or moving latest stable away from v1.0.0.
Publishing or claiming validation for any non-macOS target or hosted cross-platform matrix.
Task9 script migration or changes to the WI-1050 repair implementation.
intent.problem: The current stable release is v1.0.0 and does not contain the WI-1050 amendment-admission repair, so Mac operators lack a bounded public candidate for trial before Task9.
intent.rationale: A macOS-only prerelease lets operators trial the separately authorized repair without conflating it with Task9 or changing the stable release.
intent.userGoal: Mac users can obtain and try a prerelease containing the WI-1050 amendment-admission repair; the change is intended to avoid the known self-lock around authorized Contract amendments. This prerelease is a trial build, not a claim of verified stable behavior.

outOfScope: A stable release or moving latest stable away from v1.0.0.
Publishing a non-macOS artifact or claiming hosted cross-platform verification.
Task9 script migration or modification of WI-1050 repair source files.
Bypassing normal GitHub permissions, rewriting existing tags, or globally installing/overwriting Runtime.

constraints: No rollback or provider cleanup is performed by this amendment.
If normal GitHub permissions do not permit withdrawal/removal, stop and report the exact provider refusal.
steps: If the candidate is defective, keep v1.0.0 as latest stable and withdraw the exact v1.0.1-rc.1 prerelease using normal GitHub permissions.
Remove only the v1.0.1-rc.1 release assets and candidate tag if the provider record still matches this Work Item and normal permissions allow; do not rewrite or remove v1.0.0 or unrelated tags.
Preserve the release, verification, and cleanup records; issue any corrected candidate under a new prerelease version rather than replacing the published identity.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The release-candidate source is bound to the exact WI-1050 commit/tree and excludes all Task9 changes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect exact Git commit/tree ancestry and changed paths immediately before release; retain the resulting source identity evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A fresh aarch64-apple-darwin release artifact reports 1.0.1-rc.1 and launches from an isolated install prefix.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Build from the final release candidate source, compare version output, and install/run from a temporary prefix without changing the global Runtime.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The WI-1050 authorized amendment path succeeds, unauthorized/mismatched requests fail closed without writes, and supported legacy receipts remain readable.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the named WI-1050 positive, denial/zero-write, and legacy-read regression tests on the exact release source; preserve their actual results without converting local tests into Runtime review.

scenarioCoverage.expected: After publication, the exact GitHub prerelease is marked prerelease and exposes only the macOS arm64 executable and matching SHA-256 checksum; the downloaded asset bytes verify against that checksum.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Keep this scenario pending before publication. Only after the exact release exists, inspect its provider record, download its executable and checksum, and verify the downloaded bytes; do not treat local checksum generation as downloaded-asset evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: v1.0.0 remains the latest stable release before and after the prerelease operation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Before publication, record the provider's latest-stable pointer and confirm it is v1.0.0; after publication, recheck that the latest-stable pointer remains v1.0.0. Keep the post-publication portion pending until the provider release exists.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Release notes clearly limit this to a macOS arm64 trial and disclose any unresolved Runtime review/verification, hosted CI, and non-macOS validation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Review the exact published notes against the observed verification receipts and provider data before declaring release acceptance.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The documented withdrawal path targets only v1.0.1-rc.1 and leaves v1.0.0 and unrelated tags untouched.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Before publication, review and retain the exact withdrawal/removal instructions. This acceptance checks the instructions only; do not mutate provider releases, assets, or tags unless withdrawal is actually needed and separately authorized.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Before publication, the local macOS arm64 executable and generated SHA-256 sidecar are bound to the final candidate source and verify against each other.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: After the final aarch64-apple-darwin release build and before publication, generate a SHA-256 sidecar for the exact executable, verify the local digest, and retain the source commit/tree binding. Do not describe this as a downloaded GitHub asset check.
